annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that an origin server MAY send a 200 (OK) response containing the result and a Content-Location header field whose value is the same as the POST's effective request URI. The terminology is defined elsewhere (Section 3.1.4.2), and the clause does not leave any implementation‑relevant constraint unspecified. No two materially different interpretations arise from the wording.
